cards.summary: CART0-PROFILE-1 authorizes deterministic no-model conformance repair and receipts; model/provider dispatch and gated changes remain forbidden.
Do not change graders, pass criteria, tasks, hidden vectors, ledger closure, or cost accounting; do not mint a benchmark verdict or receipt.
CART0 is a tiny control projection plus a decision-boundary gate. Keep full history out of the foreground; dispatch constraints mechanically and retrieve evidence by pointer.
Separate powers: isolated agents may propose, Console records human review, custody seals bytes, retrieval opens high-resolution terrain, and CART0 preserves lawful continuation.
